scope: frontend form interaction source audit only

notes: Task 6 owns frontend/docs/design/app-vue/verification-pack/api/runtime/ and was in_progress during this audit.

frontend/src/services/mycampusService.js:205-214 uploads a selected file as FormData to filesApi.upload.
